verdict.rationale: The evidence documents only JSON output with word-level timestamps and a plaintext transcript version. Nothing mentions an SRT or VTT caption export via the API or any other documented path. Timestamped JSON is a building block a developer could use to generate captions, not the caption-export capability itself.

support.subject: As a developer, I can export a transcript as SRT or VTT captions through the API or a documented path
